summary: SUMMARY: hairstyle short rounded wolf cut; armor silhouette broad shoulder and leg armor with thrusters; design idea rounded jaw-shell shoulder plates; face heart-shaped with balanced jaw and teal peach-blossom eyes; expression playful smile
free_prompt:
Input: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images. For the image tool, omit referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include.
Source: Trapinch (톱치), ground type.
Subject: A female mecha personification character with Trapinch as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.
Output: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art.

1. STYLE
High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A bright, adorable adult anime face drawn to her own Face line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones and restrained highlights on clothing and armor, keeping her own colours in soft, clean tints. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

2. CHARACTER
Face — her own structure, not the style's default face: heart-shaped face; balanced jawline; peach-blossom eyes; teal eyes; short rounded brows; short nose with upturned tip; fuller lower lip.
Hair: a short rounded wolf cut, closely cropped at the nape with fluffy outward tips and short broken bangs.
Impression (reads even at card size): a playful, confident woman in her early twenties with golden beige skin; a bright teasing smile; subtle warm blush.
Identity (chosen details override the automatic look)
body type: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.
Proportions: natural adult proportions — about 7 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. Her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.
Body: a normal human body — elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.
Hands: Keep both hands relaxed — a loose fist, an open palm or resting on something. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. ARMOR — LIGHT
Costume: one layer of thin, close-fitting hard armor that covers most of her body: a chest plate joined to segmented abdominal plates down to her hips, shoulder pauldrons, upper-arm and forearm plates with gauntlets, hip and thigh plates, knee guards, shin guards and armored boots; the fitted undersuit shows only in narrow gaps at the joints, joints free. The plates stay thin and close to her body, so the outline is slim and readable without slimming her figure. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.
Armor: rigid hard-surface mecha armor — solid plates of enamelled metal and ceramic with visible thickness, bevelled edges, layered rims, panel lines, seams, small vents, sensor lights and mechanical joints, casting real shadows onto the undersuit. The plates sit on top of her body as separate machined parts, never printed or painted onto fabric, never a patterned bodysuit.
Silhouette: heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.
Design idea: Trapinch's round head and zigzag jaw opening shape the overlapping semicircular shoulder plates; recessed tooth-shaped interlocks form the rim of each shell rather than an attached decoration.
Colours: white, brown.
Exposure: armor and undersuit open by design only at a deep neckline window with cleavage, and bare upper thighs; everywhere else fully covered. Plates stay on and symmetrical; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
Composition: Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face.
Pose: Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.
Setting detail: A pale dune ridge beside a weathered rock arch, with warm daylight and distant drifting sand.
Type effects: One open hand conjuring an amber earthen glow amid rising dust and small pebbles. Her whole silhouette is outlined by an amber earthen glow, clearly visible as a bright rim of light along her body and armor. Rising dust and small pebbles circle slowly around her.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only.
Avoid: second character, creature beside her, text, lettering, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, extra limbs.
